description: The Economics and Statistics Office of the Cayman Islands publishes its 2021 Population and Housing Census report as separate PDF sections. Section 10 holds 24 household and housing tables by district, each as counts and percentages: household size, ownership, dwelling type, rooms and bathrooms, type of sewerage, main source of water, use of bottled drinking water, cooking fuel, type of lighting, household production of renewable energy for own use and for sale, and access to amenities. Coverage is national across six districts; for example, of 29,699 households, 26,883 had mains water (city water or desalinated) and 1,020 used a cistern. The 2010 census is also available as a REDATAM database with housing indicators by island and district. Format and access: free PDF downloads and free online tabulation, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the 2021 tables are in PDF only, so figures need extracting; the district level is coarse. Simulation uses: water supply mix and cistern reliance for drought and hurricane planning, sewerage type for wastewater capacity, and household renewable energy for distributed generation estimates. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM hub.
